scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose the root cause of the compiler errors

rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 lacks these APIs, hence FS0039
Noted a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001) are a separate real problem

scenarios.reasoning: Methodical, evidence-driven analysis that nails the primary root cause with concrete binlog proof, error-code grouping, actionable fix, and a useful heads-up about ComponentTests. It also recovered well from tool-path issues. However, it over-generalized by claiming all 170 errors are net472-only and that net10.0 is clean, missing the separate genuine net10.0 type-mismatch errors — a real analytical gap.
